d.title: Pokemon: Pikachu no Natsumatsuri
d.jp: ピカチュウのなつまつり
syn: Pocket Monsters: Pikachu no Natsu Matsuri
d.synopsis: Summer has arrived, and many Pokemon have set up shops for a summer festival on the beach. Soon the gang will be blessed by a special performance from the pop idol Azumarill, but upon her arrival, she's kidnapped by the flying Pokemon Skarmory! Pikachu, along with Plusle, Minun, Meowth, Wobbuffet and a number of other Pokemon must now track down the singing beauty; the show must go on!
